title: Observer pattern participants
purpose: Show subject/observer abstractions and concrete pull-style state access.
alt: Subject·Observer 인터페이스와 구체 구현, 관찰자 목록 및 상태 조회 관계
requiredChecks: Subject interface registerObserver(), removeObserver(), notifyObservers(); Observer interface update().
ConcreteSubject implements Subject; has getState()/setState() and an observer list.
ConcreteObserver implements Observer and references ConcreteSubject for state access.
Subject notifies Observer.update(); observer reads subject state, not reverse inheritance.
